targets.name: nfw-ipv6-gap-target
targets.planted_condition: Dual-stack listener on TCP 8080 with IPv4 policy dropping TCP 8080, while IPv6 has no drop rule and accepts connections

expectations.why: Dual-family probe samples both IPv4 and IPv6 on port 8080 against declared deny; IPv4 is dropped, but IPv6 accepts handshake, producing a family parity mismatch and violating the declared deny on IPv6
Declared IPv6 target on port 8080 accepts a TCP connect from the probe worker, violating the declared deny policy that restricts the IPv4 path

verification: curl from a container on anl-nfw-ipv6-gap-net to 172.31.33.10:8080 times out due to IPv4 iptables DROP rule
curl from a container on anl-nfw-ipv6-gap-net to [fd00:a57a:33::10]:8080 connects and returns HTTP 200 app-ok
curl from a container on anl-nfw-ipv6-gap-net to 172.31.33.10:80 and [fd00:a57a:33::10]:80 returns HTTP 200 healthy
